channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about De'Andre Hunter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about De'Andre Hunter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Bogdan Bogdanovic, De'Andre Hunter, Dyson Daniels, Zaccharie Risacher
item.description:
Hawks coach Quin Snyder said Saturday.

“So, I don’t look at it as a positional thing where (we) talk about backup this. It’s the same way you look at a wing. Dyson (Daniels) is not Hunt’s (De’Andre Hunter) backup, Zacch’s (Zaccharie Risacher) not Dyson’s backup. Bogi’s (Bogdan Bogdanovic) not Zacch’s backup. Like you have players, and the most important thing is (how) the team functions. And that means, when I say functions, it’s successful.”

Quin Snyder on Bogdan Bogdanovic, De'Andre Hunter, Dyson Daniels, Zaccharie Risacher, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter
item.description:
McMillan on De'Andre Hunter:

“We feel he's getting a little better, but he is just not feeling comfortable enough to play. What we want to do is get him in some type of live scrimmage before we put him out on the floor, and we just haven't had the time to do that.”

Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter:

“... When a guy is coming back like this, he's already nervous about stepping out on the floor, you just want to put him in a position where he's not putting a lot of pressure on himself,work himself back into shape, into rhythm.”

Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter, Mar 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Kevin Huerter on De'Andre Hunter
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Kevin Huerter on potentially getting De'Andre Hunter back:

“It's going to mean a lot... A key piece on both sides of the ball. We're happy to see him get back out there. He's looked pretty good in the workouts so far. It's nice having him back on this road trip.”

Kevin Huerter on De'Andre Hunter, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter
item.description:
Chris Kirschner:Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter's rehab:

“He's doing well. His rehab is coming along. He's out on the floor working. We're hoping he'll be able to join the team soon.”

Nate McMillan on De'Andre Hunter, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisKirschner.
